svg.title: KHAIFAW / ACTIVITY CONSTELLATION
svg.desc: Animated public contribution calendar for KhaiFaw: 63 contributions, 11 active days, longest streak 3 days. Days are visited in chronological order; only contribution days light up. More contributions produce brighter cubes. The completed grid holds, then resets.
svg.text: One day at a time. More contributions, brighter cubes.
